zh.title: Corendon Airlines客機疑似空中緊急狀況 由Eurofighter護送降落紐倫堡
zh.summary: 紐倫堡機場因Corendon客機疑似空中緊急狀況暫停航班，客機安全降落。
body: 紐倫堡機場（NUE）於2026年10月13日在當局接獲通報後暫停航班作業；通報稱，一架自希臘科孚島（Corfu）飛抵的Corendon Airlines客機可能發生空中緊急狀況。德國空軍Eurofighter戰機護送客機前往機場，該機安全降落。
AeroTime指出，涉事飛機為波音737-800。機場發言人稱，客機應答機據報在接近紐倫堡時曾發送7500代碼。中法蘭克尼亞警方表示，當局正調查原因；警方發言人稱，疑似空中緊急狀況尚未確認。

en.title: Corendon Airlines jet escorted to Nuremberg amid reported in-flight emergency
en.summary: Nuremberg Airport suspended flights after a reported emergency; Corendon’s jet landed safely under escort.
body: Nuremberg Airport (NUE) suspended flight operations on October 13, 2026, after authorities received a report of a possible in-flight emergency aboard a Corendon Airlines passenger aircraft arriving from Corfu, Greece. German Air Force Eurofighter jets escorted the aircraft to the airport, where it landed safely.

AeroTime identified the aircraft as a Boeing 737-800. An airport spokesperson said its transponder had reportedly transmitted squawk 7500 during its approach to Nuremberg. Middle Franconia police said investigations into the cause were underway. A police spokesperson said the suspected air emergency had not yet been confirmed.

zh.title: 李在明歡迎北極航線貨櫃輪返國 韓國拚2030年前開通定期服務
zh.summary: 韓國總統李在明在釜山歡迎完成北極航線往返歐洲的貨櫃輪返國；當局規劃2027年再試航，目標2030年開通定期服務。
body: （中央社首爾13日綜合外電報導）韓國總統李在明今天歡迎首艘經由北極航線成功往返歐洲的韓國貨櫃輪返國。路透社報導，李在明在釜山的儀式中親自為泛星海運集團（PanStar）這艘PanStar Acro號貨櫃輪的船長及船員獻上花環。
這艘貨櫃輪於11日返抵韓國，完成長達50天航程，期間曾停靠英國費利克斯託（Felixstowe）、荷蘭鹿特丹（Rotterdam）及波蘭格但斯克（Gdansk）等地。
李在明表示：「我們已經清楚體認到，一旦既有海運航線遭到阻斷，韓國經濟會受到多大衝擊。」他意指中東衝突對航運路線造成的影響。他並表示：「新開闢的北極航線可能成為另一條航道、另一個在危機時可以依賴的選擇。」
當局指出，隨著氣候暖化導致北方海域冰層縮減，這條航線變得更容易通行，應該會比蘇伊士運河（Suez Canal）航線縮減約1/3航行時間。
海洋水產部長官黃鐘宇表示，預計於2027年進行進一步試航，將派出貨櫃輪與汽車運輸船參與，目標是在2030年正式啟動定期航班服務。黃鐘宇預期，該航線可望約在2040年達成經濟效益；15年內，船隻每年可在這條航線上航行超過半年。
此外，韓國也將評估亞洲與北美洲之間西北航道的潛力。不過現階段航線緊貼著俄羅斯的北極海岸，恐引發與西方盟國的摩擦；西方目前正試圖孤立因烏克蘭戰爭而受到制裁的莫斯科。

en.title: South Korea's Lee welcomes return of Arctic route container ship, targets 2030 regular service
en.summary: President Lee Jae Myung welcomed the PanStar Acro home in Busan after its Arctic round trip to Europe; further trials are planned for 2027, with regular service targeted for 2030.
body: SEOUL, Oct. 13 (CNA) -- South Korean President Lee Jae Myung on Tuesday welcomed home the first South Korean container ship to complete a round trip to Europe via the Arctic route. According to Reuters, Lee personally presented a wreath to the captain and crew of the PanStar Acro, operated by PanStar, at a ceremony in Busan.
The container ship returned to South Korea on the 11th after a voyage of 50 days, during which it called at Felixstowe in the United Kingdom, Rotterdam in the Netherlands and Gdansk in Poland.

Lee said, "We have clearly recognised how greatly the South Korean economy would be affected once existing shipping routes are blocked," referring to the impact of Middle East conflict on shipping lanes. He added that "the newly opened Arctic route could become another sea lane, another option to rely on in a crisis."
Authorities noted that as global warming shrinks sea ice in northern waters, the route has become more navigable and should cut voyage times by about one third compared with the Suez Canal route.

Minister of Oceans and Fisheries Hwang Jong-woo said further trial voyages are expected in 2027, with container ships and car carriers taking part, and that the goal is to officially launch regular scheduled services in 2030. Hwang expects the route to achieve economic benefits around 2040, and said that within 15 years vessels could sail the route for more than half of each year.

South Korea will also assess the potential of the Northwest Passage between Asia and North America. At this stage, however, the route hugs Russia's Arctic coast, which could cause friction with Western allies; the West is currently seeking to isolate Moscow over sanctions imposed because of the war in Ukraine.

zh.title: 達美航空234號班機在本古裏安機場（TLV）受檢，未發現可信威脅
zh.summary: 達美航空234號班機在本古裏安機場受檢，未發現可信威脅。
body: 達美航空表示，234號班機在本古裏安機場落地後，乘客下機，並由當地主管機關檢查，以評估潛在安全疑慮。以色列媒體曾報導，該班機因炸彈威脅而被隔離；達美航空表示，檢查未發現可信威脅，乘客與機組員均安全送往航廈。
以色列機場管理局發言人表示，本古裏安機場安全人員已徹底檢查飛機，未發現異常，機場運作已恢復正常。AeroTime指出，涉事飛機為達美航空 Airbus A330neo，註冊編號 N423DX。

en.title: Delta Flight 234 inspected at Ben Gurion Airport (TLV); no credible threat found
en.summary: Delta Flight 234 was inspected at Ben Gurion Airport; no credible threat was found.
body: Delta Air Lines said Flight 234 was deplaned after landing at Ben Gurion Airport (TLV) and inspected by local authorities to assess a potential security issue. Israeli media reported that the aircraft had been isolated following a bomb threat. Delta said no credible threat was found, and customers and crew were transported safely to the terminal.

An Israel Airports Authority spokesperson said Ben Gurion Airport security personnel thoroughly inspected the aircraft and found no unusual findings, adding that operations had returned to normal. AeroTime identified the aircraft as a Delta Airbus A330neo, registration N423DX.

zh.title: 沙烏地哈立德國王國際機場遭襲 外交部：1名臺籍民眾受傷
zh.summary: 外交部表示哈立德國王國際機場遭襲造成1名臺籍民眾受傷，駐處已前往探視並提供協助
body: （中央社記者楊堯茹臺北13日電）沙烏地阿拉伯哈立德國王國際機場遭襲擊。外交部今天表示，1名臺籍民眾受波及受傷，臺灣駐處已前往探視及提供協助。
外交部透過新聞稿說明，葉門青年運動對哈立德國王國際機場的攻擊已造成1名臺籍民眾受傷，外交部對於葉門青年運動攻擊他國、破壞民用設施等行徑予以強烈譴責，並向罹難者家屬及傷者表達誠摯慰問。
外交部表示，駐沙烏地阿拉伯代表處於獲悉民眾受傷後，第一時間即進行瞭解並派員前往醫院探視，表達政府慰問與關懷之意，及提供必要協助。外交部及駐處將持續掌握當地臺灣民眾情形，並密切關注相關情勢發展。
中央社引述路透社報導指出，與伊朗結盟的葉門青年運動持續發動攻擊，沙烏地阿拉伯利雅德上空已不見航班蹤影；當局將哈立德國王國際機場的關閉期限延長至週六（10月17日），各航空公司也紛紛取消航班。
外交部領事事務局12日針對沙烏地阿拉伯與葉門邊界地區納季蘭（Najran），調升旅遊警示到「第四級：紅色儘速離境」，提醒民眾倘因必要事由前往鄰近地區，應避免接近邊境、軍事設施及其他敏感地點。
領務局11日針對沙烏地阿拉伯全境發布「第三級：橙色避免前往」旅遊警示，建議暫時避免前往利雅德哈立德國王國際機場及周邊地區、減少非必要外出。

en.title: Saudi airport attack injures one Taiwanese national, foreign ministry says
en.summary: Taiwan's foreign ministry says one Taiwanese national was injured in the attack on King Khalid International Airport; the representative office has visited and offered assistance
body: TAIPEI (Central News Agency) - One Taiwanese national was injured in the attack on Saudi Arabia's King Khalid International Airport, Taiwan's Ministry of Foreign Affairs said on October 13, adding that the representative office had visited the person and offered assistance.

In a press release, the ministry said the attack by the Iran-aligned Houthis had injured one Taiwanese national. It strongly condemned the Houthis for attacking other countries and damaging civilian facilities, and expressed condolences to the families of the deceased and to the injured.

The ministry said Taiwan's representative office in Saudi Arabia, after learning of the injury, immediately sought information and sent staff to visit the hospital to convey the government's concern and provide necessary assistance, and would keep tracking the situation of Taiwanese nationals there.

Central News Agency, citing a Reuters report, said the Iran-aligned Houthis have continued attacks, no flights were visible over Riyadh, authorities extended the closure of King Khalid International Airport to Saturday, October 17, and airlines cancelled flights.

The Bureau of Consular Affairs on October 12 raised its travel advisory for the Saudi-Yemen border area of Najran to Level 4: Red, leave the area immediately, urging people travelling there for essential reasons to avoid the border, military facilities and other sensitive locations.

On October 11, the bureau issued a Level 3: Orange, avoid travel advisory for all of Saudi Arabia, advising people to temporarily avoid Riyadh's King Khalid International Airport and surrounding areas and to reduce non-essential outings.

zh.title: NASA據報接觸前SR-71工程人員探討重返飛行
zh.summary: NASA據報接觸前SR-71工程人員，探討飛機重返飛行可能性。
body: 《Aviation Week》報導，NASA已接觸多名前SR-71工程人員，詢問是否能協助讓飛機重返飛行。報導指出，這架飛機名為NASA 844，最後一次飛行是在1999年10月9日。
《Aviation Week》另報導，NASA已將飛機移入一處曾供太空梭使用的機庫，地點在愛德華茲空軍基地。NASA尚未公開確認重返飛行計畫，也未說明打算如何使用這架飛機；目前重返飛行仍未獲公開確認。

en.title: NASA reportedly contacts former SR-71 engineers about possible return to flight
en.summary: NASA reportedly approached former SR-71 engineers about helping return the aircraft to flight.
body: Aviation Week reported that NASA had approached former SR-71 engineers about helping return the aircraft to flight. The aircraft, known as NASA 844, last flew on 9 October 1999, according to the report.

Aviation Week also reported that NASA had moved the aircraft into a hangar formerly used for the Space Shuttle at Edwards Air Force Base. NASA has not publicly confirmed a return-to-flight programme or explained what it intends to do with the aircraft. A return to flight has therefore not been publicly confirmed.

zh.title: 棕櫚泉航空博物館安排五場活動開放民眾參觀迪士尼私人飛機
zh.summary: 棕櫚泉航空博物館安排五場晚間活動，開放民眾進入迪士尼私人飛機參觀
body: 棕櫚泉航空博物館安排在October 2026至April 2027間舉行五場特別晚間活動，讓一般民眾進入華特迪士尼私人飛機內部參觀。報導指出，不屬於迪士尼官方D23粉絲組織的民眾也可參加，活動將在加州棕櫚泉航空博物館舉行。
開放參觀的飛機是與華特迪士尼相關、登記號N732G的Grumman Gulfstream I。每場活動都將安排機內導覽；特別體驗為兩小時，重新整修的機艙內裝是體驗重點。

en.title: Palm Springs Air Museum schedules five public tours inside Disney’s Gulfstream I
en.summary: Palm Springs Air Museum schedules five evenings for public tours inside Walt Disney’s aircraft.
body: The Palm Springs Air Museum has scheduled five special evening events between October 2026 and April 2027. The events will allow members of the general public who are not part of Disney’s official D23 fan organisation to experience the interior of Walt Disney’s last personal aircraft at the museum in California.

The aircraft is a Grumman Gulfstream I registered as N732G and associated with Walt Disney. Each event will include a guided experience inside the aircraft. The newly restored interior is described as the highlight of the museum’s special two-hour experiences.

zh.title: Assaia報告：改善航機周轉每年最多可省US$44bn
zh.summary: Assaia估計改善航機周轉每年可為航空公司節省最高US$44bn。
body: 航空科技公司Assaia分析指出，2026年第一季，歐洲及北美的航機平均在地面停留時間比排定時間多11.1分鐘。
一份新產業報告估計，改善航機周轉表現每年最多可為航空公司節省US$44bn。Assaia表示，這項計算以每分鐘延誤成本100美元估算，並將約11分鐘的超時套用於相關航班。
Assaia分析了歐洲及北美超過75萬次航機周轉，探討為何部分作業能接近排程完成，另一些則超時超過20分鐘。報告聚焦航機抵達停機位至準備起飛的周轉作業。

en.title: Assaia report estimates airlines could save up to $44bn a year through faster turnarounds
en.summary: Assaia estimates turnaround improvements could save airlines up to $44bn annually.
body: Aviation technology company Assaia found that aircraft in Europe and North America spent an average of 11.1 minutes longer on the ground than scheduled in the first quarter of 2026.

A new industry report estimates that improving aircraft turnaround performance could save airlines up to $44bn annually. Assaia said its calculation uses an estimated cost of $100 for each minute of delay and an 11-minute overrun across the flights.

Assaia analysed more than 750,000 turnarounds across Europe and North America to examine why some operations finish close to schedule while others overrun by more than 20 minutes. The report focuses on the period between an aircraft arriving at its stand and departing for its next flight.

zh.title: Avealto尋求5,500萬美元 規劃肯特設廠並推出馬來西亞商業服務
zh.summary: Avealto尋求5,500萬美元，規劃肯特設廠並在馬來西亞推出商業服務
body: Avealto表示正尋求5,500萬美元，以在肯特設立製造設施，並在馬來西亞推出首個商業服務。這項服務仍屬規劃中的方案。
公司提出的飛船長度約100公尺，預計在約65,000英尺高度運作，並在同一地點上空近乎定點停留，每次可持續三至四個月。
Avealto表示，每艘飛船可提供直徑約240公里的通訊涵蓋範圍，並透過回傳鏈路連接傳統行動電話基地臺與電信業者的網路。

en.title: Avealto Seeks $55 Million for Kent Facility and Planned Malaysia Service
en.summary: Avealto seeks $55 million for a planned Kent facility and Malaysia service
body: Avealto is seeking $55 million to establish a manufacturing facility in Kent and launch its first commercial service in Malaysia. The company’s service remains a proposal.

The proposed airships would be about 100 metres (330 feet) long and operate at around 65,000 feet. Avealto says they would remain almost stationary above the same location for three to four months at a time.

The company says each airship would provide communications coverage across a 240-kilometre-diameter area. Rather than connecting ordinary mobile phones directly to aircraft, the airships would provide backhaul linking conventional mobile phone towers to an operator’s wider network.

zh.summary: Jet2撤出La Palma，取消曼徹斯特航班及未啟航的斯坦斯特德航線。
body: Jet2表示，檢視飛航計畫及顧客需求後，決定撤出La Palma的航班與假期。該公司取消曼徹斯特（Manchester）—La Palma服務，也放棄原定由倫敦斯坦斯特德（London Stansted）開辦的航線；斯坦斯特德服務尚未啟航。
曼徹斯特—La Palma最後一班預定航班預計於10月30日執飛；該服務始於4月3日。Jet2表示，會聯絡受影響顧客，提供退款或替代假期安排，並為造成的不便致歉。

en.title: Jet2 withdraws from La Palma, cancelling Manchester and planned Stansted flights
en.summary: Jet2 withdraws from La Palma, ending Manchester flights and dropping planned Stansted service.
body: Jet2 said it is withdrawing flights and holidays to La Palma after reviewing its flying programme and customer demand. The decision cancels the Manchester service and abandons a planned route from London Stansted. Jet2’s last scheduled Manchester–La Palma flight is due to operate on 30 October; the service began on 3 April.

Flights from Stansted were due to start on 6 November, but the planned route was dropped before launch. Jet2 said it would contact affected customers, offering refunds or alternative holiday arrangements, and apologised for the disruption.

zh.title: EAGLE地效飛行器概念於雪梨揭示 發明者稱可望2035年營運
zh.summary: EAGLE概念於雪梨ICAS會議揭示；發明者認為可望2035年投入營運
body: EAGLE地效飛行器概念已在雪梨舉行的ICAS會議揭示，報導並稱首項專利數週前剛核發。發明者Dr Mithra Sankrithi認為，EAGLE可能在2035年投入營運；這是對未來可行性的看法，並非已投入服務。
報導將 ekranoplan 說明為貼近水面飛行、利用氣墊提升效率的地效飛行器。構想中的載具可環球航行，搭載5萬名乘客及逾1,000個貨櫃。Sankrithi描述的營運模式則是少數船艇每週停靠30至45次，分別向東、西航行。

en.title: EAGLE ekranoplan concept unveiled in Sydney; inventor sees possible 2035 operation
en.summary: EAGLE was unveiled in Sydney; its inventor says it could operate by 2035.
body: The EAGLE ekranoplan concept was unveiled at the ICAS conference in Sydney, and the report says its first patent was issued just weeks ago. Inventor Dr Mithra Sankrithi believes the vehicle could be operational by 2035; this is a projection, not a report that it has entered service. An ekranoplan, also known as a wing-in-ground-effect vehicle, flies just above water using an air cushion to improve efficiency.

The proposed vehicle is described as carrying 50,000 passengers and more than 1,000 shipping containers while circling the globe. Sankrithi's outlined operating model calls for a small number of vessels making 30 to 45 stops a week, with one heading east and another west.
